tasks.title: Ask for key points
tasks.instructions: Prepare the tutor settings, then ask the tutor to explain active recall using only the key points. Compare the four results after any clarification questions have been answered. This is a practice task.

tasks.title: Ask for a shorter explanation
tasks.instructions: Prepare the tutor settings, then ask for a slightly shorter explanation of spaced practice. Decide what a useful shorter answer means to you and express your request naturally. Compare the four results. This is a practice task.

tasks.title: Speech rate practice 1
tasks.instructions: Ask the tutor to speak a little more slowly while keeping the other settings unchanged. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.

tasks.title: Speech rate practice 2
tasks.instructions: Ask the tutor to return to its default speaking speed. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.

tasks.title: Tone practice 1
tasks.instructions: Ask the tutor to use a friendly wording style while keeping the other settings unchanged. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.

tasks.title: Tone practice 2
tasks.instructions: Ask the tutor to use an encouraging wording style after a practice mistake. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.

tasks.title: Voice practice 1
tasks.instructions: Listen to the available voice samples, then ask the tutor to use Voice D. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.

tasks.title: Voice practice 2
tasks.instructions: Ask the tutor to use another available voice of your choice. Keep the pace and tone unchanged. Compare all four results after any clarifications. This is a practice task, not a formal study task.
